findings.title: Sub-agent budget was enforced only after execution
findings.resolution: Added a parent-owned ExecutionAllowance to ToolContext and clamp every child RunBudget before dispatch.

findings.title: Remote tools could return unbounded output or repeat MCP cursors
findings.resolution: Bound all dispatcher output and added MCP page, tool-count, and repeated-cursor guards.

findings.title: Cancelled test commands could leave descendant processes running
findings.resolution: Terminate the subprocess session's process group on cancellation and wait for its exit.

findings.title: Locked pytest version had a published vulnerability
findings.resolution: Raised the test dependency floor to pytest 9.0.3, resolved 9.1.1, reran all tests, and obtained a clean pip-audit result.

findings.title: Filesystem confinement is not an OS sandbox
findings.resolution: Keep path and symlink checks plus exact write approval; require a disposable user-selected worktree and explicitly defer OS isolation.

findings.title: Trace redaction cannot classify arbitrary sensitive source text
findings.resolution: Redact credential-shaped keys and values, document the boundary, and keep trace storage local by default.

findings.title: Approval grants are not durable across CLI processes
findings.resolution: Persist run checkpoints but constrain approvals to the interactive process; defer a durable approval service rather than imply crash-safe approval resume.

findings.title: No real-model or SWE-bench quality result is included
findings.resolution: Keep credentialed benchmarks optional and prohibit quantitative quality claims until a revision-bound report exists.
